_comment: Best-effort rate monitor used by update.py. For each entry it fetches 'url', applies 'regex' (first capture group = a percentage like 3.00), and compares to the matching field in data/rates.json. It only REPORTS mismatches; it never edits data. Selectors break often, so treat failures as 'go verify manually', not as truth. Add entries as you confirm stable source URLs.
